question: "Jagritam Aharnisham" or "Always Alert" is the motto of which organization?
solution:
The correct answer is the __**Intelligence Bureau**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The motto “**Jagritam Aharnisham” or “Always Alert” is the motto of the Intelligence Bureau (IB) of India**
 
• The motto **represents the IB's tradition of always being alert and protecting the country.**
 
• The IB is India's domestic intelligence agency, responsible fo**r counter-intelligence, counter-terrorism, and internal security.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Indian Coast Guard

 
 
• It is an Armed Force, Search and Rescue and Maritime Law Enforcement agency under the Ministry of Defence.
 
• The Director-General of the Indian Coast Guard: Rakesh Pal
 
• Indian Coast Guard Headquarters is in New Delhi.
 
 
 
• **​Indian Army**:
 
 
• The Indian Army **protects the nation's land borders** from external threats and aggression.
 
• It plays a **key role in humanitarian aid** and disaster relief during natural calamities.
 
• The Army is actively **involved in counter-insurgency operations in troubled regions like Jammu & Kashmir and the Northeast.**
 
 
 
• **Research and Analysis Wing (RAW):**
 
 
• RAW is India's **external intelligence agency,** responsible for gathering information on foreign threats.
 
• It **plays a significant role in counter-terrorism by identifying and neutralizing external threats to India.**
 
• RAW **conducts covert operations abroad to safeguard India's** national security and strategic interests.
